notes: Identity checked in canonical source: An Agenda for Purely Confirmatory Research; Eric-Jan Wagenmakers, Ruud Wetzels, Denny Borsboom, Han L. J. van der Maas, and Rogier A. Kievit; DOI 10.1177/1745691612463078; Perspectives on Psychological Science 7(6), 632–638 (2012). This is the primary article reporting its own confirmatory replication. Text includes main article pages 632–638 and references; not an abstract or preregistration. Linked online appendix not supplied. No PDF assigned. Original source unassigned and not examined. Input does not distinguish analysis 2 (session 1) from analysis 6 (sessions 1 and 2 combined). Candidates for combined sessions only: BF01 = 16.6, default prior; BF02 = 6.2, knowledge-based prior. These are Bayes factors, not d or t; no conversion. Figure 2 supports H0 for erotic stimuli, a failed replication narrative for combined sessions, retained as candidate only because target session is unresolved. Session-1 results require missing appendix. N unassigned. Authors explicitly decided not to compute p values for the prespecified replication analyses.
